svg.text: between two true dates. Each stated fact was true. The checker cannot see that a

svg.text: Four were the model putting an advisory that does not apply into its list of IDs.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two were an extra claim on an NVD record the code cannot check. One was a verdict

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that needs a KEV claim, one an answer with no claim, and one a checker fault.

svg.text: Retrieval is the limit. The top 10 held all the evidence for 53 of the 88 answerable questions.

svg.text: Evidence retrieved: 53 questions. The model's raw reply was right on 52.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So accuracy is bounded by how often the right records reach the model, and the model does well when they do. The roadmap starts there.
